name: 25531-loraprefill-30ba3b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, public and ungated, ~57 GB of bf16 weights, plus ONE LoRA adapter on top: `yushengsu/lora-diff-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507`, r=32, alpha=32, dropout 0, PEFT `target_modules: all-linear`, 1.976 GB. It is published as an HF *dataset* repo, so a dataset repo id does not resolve as a model and the launch config names a local snapshot path.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on one node, out of the node's eight.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One server, no router, no external cache tier. First bring-up is slow: CUDA-graph capture at TP=4 with the LoRA kernels recorded can look like a hang.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap; each stream refills as it completes, so the load is sustained and every request carries queueing.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42, prompts 2048 tokens FIXED and generations 128 tokens FIXED (no stdev on either); `ignore_eos` is on by default, and the synthetic prompts share no prefix, so every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A domain-tuned 30B assistant drafting short replies from long two-thousand-token briefs, 128 concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented continuation line is skipped, so a structured value has
# to stay on ONE line or the key is dropped and the engine starts without it at rc=0.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 4

# LOAD-BEARING. Every request reaches the adapter through the request body's `lora_path: my_lora`
# (scenario.json, backend extras). served-model-name is left to the serving layer: this engine
# refuses a colon in it, so the `<name>:my_lora` model-string form cannot be served. A request
# without `lora_path` is answered from the base weights at rc=0.

# A local path because the adapter is published as an HF *dataset* repo and a dataset repo id
# does not resolve as a model.
lora-paths: ["my_lora=${SYSAGENT_HF_HOME}/hub/datasets--yushengsu--lora-diff-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507/snapshots/4e6c816b31d23e02c2d0bf92638a44e5162e695d"]
max-lora-rank: 32
max-loras-per-batch: 2
lora-use-virtual-experts: true
experts-shared-outer-loras: true

moe-runner-backend: triton
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
